name: minidev
description: Ramon's development cycle for Claude Code.

plugins.name: minidev
plugins.description: A fixed development cycle: plan and scaffold new projects (brainstorm), interview ideas (grilling), keep BACKLOG/SPEC/CHANGELOG (document), build features test-first with an independent tester and reviewer (build), fix bugs test-first (fix), make behavior-preserving changes like refactors, upgrades and test pruning with the suite green before and after (chore), run a few backlog items in parallel to the main branch (swarm), and set up any project for it (setup).
